messages:
Nina R.: FYI I hit a funky issue while trying the SampleKit Next-edge starter with the LlamaIndex adapter. The example's client-side import of the prompt utils is resolving to `undefined`.
Ethan P.: can you paste the import line and the error you see in the browser?
Nina R.: import: `import { assemblePrompt } from 'samplekit/prompts'` -> console: `TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'assemble')` when the eval harness runs.
Devon (devex): that sounds like the published bundle exposes ESM only but the example is pulling the CJS entrypoint. Did we release the dual-entry fix to the samplekit package?
Ravi: I checked package.json in the example repo — it points to `main: dist/index.cjs.js` but rollup output created `dist/index.mjs` only. Might be an accidental publish config change.
Nina R.: repro steps: clone, `pnpm i`, `pnpm dev --filter examples/samplekit`, open /examples/samplekit/edge-demo, start the eval harness, and the stream fails on first prompt.
Ethan P.: additionally, when running in local edge emulation the auth token rotation fails sometimes during streaming. It looks like the browser SDK returns 401 mid-stream and we don't recover. Repro: run harness with long prompt, after ~70s the refresh attempt times out and SSE stream closes.
Devon (devex): two things to fix short-term: 1) samplekit packaging: ensure package.json includes both "exports" and dual fields for main/module and correct d.ts mappings; 2) example should wrap calls with an auth-aware retry helper that will fall back to non-streaming mode if refresh fails.
Ravi: I'll open a small change to the sample: add an `exports` map and a `types` field pointing to dist/index.d.ts. Should be a quick publishing patch.
Nina R.: for the example readme let's add a note about edge cold-start affecting ephemeral key refresh and a recommended `OPTIMISTIC_REFRESH` helper.
Ethan P.: SDK parity item: Node SDK reconnects streams on 401 but browser SDK throws. We should either align SDK behavior or make examples resilient to the difference.
Devon (devex): I'll prototype a tiny wrapper in the example: `authStreamWrapper(streamFn)` that retries token refresh up to 2x and automatically replays last chunk in non-stream fallback. Will PR after lunch.
ci-bot: CI run 511: examples/samplekit integration e2e failed  stream.spec.ts: expected stream to resume after token rotate but got 401.
Ravi: I'll add a temporary flaky tag to the test while we land the patches, and add a unit test that validates the package exports surface so future publishes don't regress.
Nina R.: thanks all. Can we also add a tiny GH Actions job to publish a dry-run package and assert both `main` and `module` entrypoints exist?
Ethan P.: yes, a `pnpm pack` + `tar -tf` check is cheap and will catch missing files. I'll sketch that in a follow-up.
Devon (devex): action items: ravi/package-exports, devon/auth-wrapper, ethan/pack-check-ci. I'll open PRs and link them here.
Nina R.: excellent. tagging @devex to track docs updates after merges. :thumbsup:
Ethan P.: ETA for pack-check PR: today EOD.
Devon (devex): auth wrapper PR tomorrow morning.
Ravi: package fix PR in ~2 hours.
